fails.text: Hacking time. Nobody touch my console.
fails.reason: Generic line with no Rigs jargon or punchline, and 'Hacking time' echoes the well-known 'It's hacking time' meme catchphrase.
fails.suggestion: Console's live. Corporate firewall, meet my drill bit.

fails.text: Pick one. Try not to overthink.
fails.reason: 'Try not to overthink' teases the player's upgrade decision rather than Rook's plans, and contradicts Rook who improvises first.
fails.suggestion: Pick one. Unlike your plans, these work.

fails.text: Foreign device detected on claim network. Session logged for review.
fails.reason: Labelled propaganda but the text is a cold bureaucratic notice; the register field contradicts the line.
fails.suggestion: Kessler-Voss networks: connecting your future, securely.

fails.text: Unregistered console connection recorded. Network access will be invoiced.
fails.reason: number-not-in-excerpt: number "27" does not appear in an excerpt of this item's log entries

fails.text: Supply crate released in restricted sector. Unauthorized retrieval will be recorded.
fails.reason: Labelled propaganda but the text is a bureaucratic warning; the register field contradicts the line.
fails.suggestion: Kessler-Voss supplies, delivered wherever your future needs them.

fails.text: Security response dispatched. Asset recovery in progress.
fails.reason: Right register, but 'Asset recovery in progress' is a near-copy of the vault example 'Asset recovery initiated.'
fails.suggestion: Security response dispatched. Irregularity containment in progress.

fails.text: Claim security units routed to extraction irregularity.
fails.reason: Labelled propaganda but the text is bureaucratic threat language ('extraction irregularity'); the register field contradicts the line.
fails.suggestion: Kessler-Voss security: protecting your future, claim by claim.

fails.text: Unregistered craft detected in claim airspace. Departure will be invoiced.
fails.reason: Labelled propaganda but the text is a cold invoicing notice; the register field contradicts the line.
fails.suggestion: Kessler-Voss skies stay safe, so your future can rise.

fails.text: Like in Speedbump: trigger first, questions later.
fails.reason: Listed film, but 'trigger first, questions later' paraphrases the well-known catchphrase 'shoot first, ask questions later'.
fails.suggestion: Like in Speedbump: the trigger's faster than the paperwork.

fails.text: Loot comes to me. Magnets, baby.
fails.reason: 'Magnets, baby' paraphrases the well-known Breaking Bad 'Yeah, magnets!' catchphrase.
fails.suggestion: Loot comes to me. Payload never looked so clingy.
